subject: geom_line with colour AND size modifications

messages.author: 9783d9fe56013431
messages.subject: geom_line with colour AND size modifications
parts:
Hi,
Everything I've tried has failed. I'm trying to modify the size of
the line while keeping the colors of the lines connected to their
names as follows

ggplot(data=subset(all, (Arm=="3R") , aes(block)) +
geom_line(aes(y=dataA, colour="M"))+
geom_line(aes(y=dataB, colour="S")) +
scale_colour_discrete("Data Type")

This gives me a nice legend with a title of Data Type and the types, M
and S, labeled with their appropriate colors.


If I just add "size" in to the aesthetic (below), colour is no longer
recognized as a valid colour name

ggplot(data=subset(all, (Arm=="3R") , aes(block)) +
geom_line(aes(y=dataA, colour="M", size=1))+
geom_line(aes(y=dataB, colour="S", size=1)) +
scale_colour_discrete("Data Type")

I want to keep things looking like they do in the first example but
modify the width of the line.

Second question is can I somehow choose the particular color I want
the lines to be as well as keeping the legend labeled nicely with the
names I've given to the lines?

Many thanks.

> ggplot(data=subset(all, (Arm=="3R") , aes(block)) +
> geom_line(aes(y=dataA, colour="M"))+
> geom_line(aes(y=dataB, colour="S")) +
> scale_colour_discrete("Data Type")
>
> This gives me a nice legend with a title of Data Type and the types, M

> If I just add "size" in to the aesthetic (below), colour is no longer
> recognized as a valid colour name
>
> ggplot(data=subset(all, (Arm=="3R") , aes(block)) +
> geom_line(aes(y=dataA, colour="M", size=1))+
> geom_line(aes(y=dataB, colour="S", size=1)) +
> scale_colour_discrete("Data Type")

If you're setting the size, it needs to go outside the aes call:

geom_line(aes(y=dataA, colour="M"), size=1)

> I want to keep things looking like they do in the first example but
> modify the width of the line.
>
> Second question is can I somehow choose the particular color I want
> the lines to be as well as keeping the legend labeled nicely with the
> names I've given to the lines?

Have a look at scale_manual.
